messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for release 2026.02.14 (canary id: canary-487). Triggering prompt/eval gate: /evals/prompt-regression. Results will post here when done. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/evals/canary-487
marie.dev: Which eval sets are we running? Did we include the new billing_prompts and long-context sets?
oliver_ml: Yes — gating set = [billing_prompts, support_long_context, signup_edgecases]. Note: we added 30 new synthetic prompts last week.
sara_prod: Heads-up: product wants to block if any >2% regression on critical billing prompts.
qa-bot: EVAL SUMMARY for canary-487
``` 
set: billing_prompts
baseline: rwd-model-v2.1.2-int8
candidate: rwd-model-v2.1.3-int8
metric: aligned_answer_rate
baseline_score: 0.938
candidate_score: 0.912
delta: -0.026
threshold: -0.02
status: FAIL
failed_examples: 7
examples_link: https://dash.redwood.ai/evals/canary-487/billing_prompts/fails
```
oliver_ml: Oof, -2.6% on billing_prompts aligned_answer_rate. That's above the -2% threshold. Looking at fails: most are due to hallucinated charge dates and missing refund steps.
marie.dev: Can we pin to v2.1.2 for the canary until ML fixes the prompt handling? I don't want this to slip into dedicated capacity.
ryan_sre: Recommend pausing rollout and marking release as gated. Run `deployctl pause canary-487` and set model pin on the route to `rwd-model-v2.1.2-int8` for now.
sara_prod: Agreed. Also update release notes with a regression entry so CS isn't surprised: "billing prompts regression observed in v2.1.3 — rolling back canary; fix in progress."
tj: I'm fine with blocking. Can we add an owner and ETA for the fix?
oliver_ml: I'll take ownership. ETA: 48 hours to push a mitigated fix (prompt tweaks + targeted fine-tune candidates) and re-run gated evals.
qa-bot: Action items recorded: [pause canary, pin model route, mark release gated, assign ML owner, re-run evals]. Ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFR-2041
marie.dev: I will update the shared release notes doc and add the CS blurb. Also scheduling note: next change window for hotfix is 2026-02-16 03:00-05:00 UTC.
sara_prod: Do we want to notify any customers on Dedicated? Might need to flag to account teams.
ryan_sre: I'll send an internal alert to account-engaging with a short summary and the ticket.
tj: Cool. Until we get green on the gating evals, no further rollout. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary canary-487 paused by ryan_sre at 1742507123. Model route pinned to rwd-model-v2.1.2-int8. Gate status: BLOCKED.
oliver_ml: I'll post a follow-up here when I have a candidate patch and new eval run. Thanks everyone.
marie.dev: Thanks — nice quick turn.
sara_prod: closing loop: include a line in release notes: "Gate triggered: prompt/eval regression on billing_prompts; canary paused & pinned to v2.1.2; fix ETA 48h (owner: oliver_ml)."
